title: Tokenearly run records
description: Two records written by every run: the exchange coverage summary and the run summary.

exchanges.title: Exchange coverage
exchanges.description: Per-exchange summary: how announcements are collected (WebSocket stream or high-frequency polling) and how many listings each exchange published in the last 30 days.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: What this run asked for and how many listings it returned, with the data licence and attribution.
